data.name: Sushma
data.gender_notes: Sushma is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + smi, 'to smile' — 'beautiful, radiant'. Its root is Sanskrit su + smi. A classical Sanskrit term for beauty. Sushma is a Sanskrit name meaning “Beautiful; well-spoken; radiant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sushma expresses “Beautiful; well-spoken; radiant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit su, 'good', + smi, 'to smile' — 'beautiful, radiant'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sushma total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
